title: more parametric functions
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate more parametric surfaces: Kuen, Pseudosphere, Bohemian Dome, Henneberg, Catalan, Bour, Plucker.

**dataset → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkActor2D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor2D.html) — actor2d.
- [vtkParametricBohemianDome](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricBohemianDome.html) — parametric bohemian dome.
- [vtkParametricBour](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricBour.html) — parametric bour.
- [vtkParametricCatalanMinimal](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricCatalanMinimal.html) — parametric catalan minimal.
- [vtkParametricFunctionSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricFunctionSource.html) — parametric function source.
- [vtkParametricHenneberg](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricHenneberg.html) — parametric henneberg.
- [vtkParametricKuen](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricKuen.html) — parametric kuen.
- [vtkParametricPluckerConoid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricPluckerConoid.html) — parametric plucker conoid.
- [vtkParametricPseudosphere](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkParametricPseudosphere.html) — parametric pseudosphere.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkTextMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTextMapper.html) — text mapper.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
